referenceComposition: Alex: The report is ready.
sourceFacts: Exact wrapper props/slots/native output from sources/react-api-inventory.json and pinned code.
contentAlternative: Speaker attribution and message content are readable text. Alignment and tint are redundant cues.
updatesAndDescendants: Bubble is a div composition with start/end alignment. BubbleContent can useRender a native action/link. BubbleReactions positions caller-provided controls; the component has no built-in reaction state, persistence or callback.
referenceDecision: The example reaction is an ordinary labelled Button owned by the caller; no fabricated like API is attached to Bubble.
keyboard: This default content wrapper does not install a keyboard listener or roving focus. Native links/buttons/inputs in the chosen children retain their own documented semantics. Label delegates native focus through its associated control.
naming: The HTML projection identifies all required visible content/labels. No unnecessary ARIA role/name is imposed on native text, headings, kbd or tables.
